privacy_audit.cookie_storage: DISALLOWED - Scanner does not persist or store cookies returned by remote servers
privacy_audit.credential_submission: DISALLOWED - Scanner never submits credentials or interacts with login forms
privacy_audit.raw_html_retention: MINIMAL - Only extracted structural evidence (titles, form schemas, headings) is persisted; raw HTML is discarded immediately
privacy_audit.pii_sanitization: ACTIVE - PII normalization strips email addresses and sensitive credentials before model tokenization
privacy_audit.user_ownership: ENFORCED - Users can view and delete their own scan history; clear history purges user scans completely
privacy_audit.external_ai_leakage: NONE - Zero user data or scan queries transmitted to external third-party AI APIs
